product_one_liner.value: Fly.io provides a developer-focused public cloud for deploying and running applications and AI agents on hardware-isolated Linux virtual machines.

named_customers.notes: Both are named among teams building on Fly.io.

hq_location.notes: Chicago is listed in the company profile and Y Combinator profile; third-party location reporting is inconsistent.

founded_year.notes: Tracxn lists 2016 as the founding year; Fly.io separately says it has been building its public cloud since 2017.

eng_blog.notes: Examples include Thomas Ptacek's posts on the implementation of Fly.io's security tokens and user-mode WireGuard networking.

public_docs.notes: Public guides and reference documentation cover Machines, Sprites, Managed Postgres, networking, and flyctl.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers index lists Fullstack Engineer, Infrastructure Operations Engineer, Account Manager (Strategic Accounts), and Networking Engineer; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: OpenRouter is an optional first-class Connector using the customer's own API key, rather than a bundled model. Anthropic and OpenAI are separately disclosed for Fly.io's internal tooling only.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type 2 report issued September 3, 2026. HIPAA support is through a BAA, not an independent HIPAA certification. Fly.io explicitly says it does not hold ISO 27001 or a PCI DSS AOC.

last_funding.notes: Announced July 24, 2026; co-led by Dell Technologies Capital and Intel Capital.

raised_18mo.notes: The $25 million Series D announced July 24, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR, or account-executive role appears in the four-role careers index. The Account Manager opening does not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: The November 9, 2026 'Pocket money for agents' announcement introduces Stripe Link wallet integration for Sprites, enabling agents to request one-time payment cards with user approval.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On July 24, 2026, Fly.io announced that Scott Johnston had joined as CEO and board member; founder Kurt Mackey would transition to an advisory role.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is listed for customer relationship management; Customer.io for newsletters and transactional email.
